usedFor: Paperform tracks document signing, TRIGGERcmd runs commands on your computers, and “Signer Signed” in Paperform can start “Trigger Command”.

bestTemplate.name: “Signer Signed” in Paperform, then “Trigger Command” in TRIGGERcmd
bestTemplate.why: It runs a command on your computers once a signer has signed the document.

watchOut: “Signer Viewed” and “Signer Notified” fire before anyone signs, so “Trigger Command” would run on them if picked.
